crossRefs.note: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”

translations.web: But if you do not forgive, neither will your Father in heaven forgive your transgressions.”
translations.kjv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father which is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
translations.asv: But if ye do not forgive, neither will your Father who is in heaven forgive your trespasses.
